title: {Syn} The Chinese Remainder Theorem Reassembles Remainders
content:
The Chinese remainder theorem says that compatible remainders modulo pairwise coprime numbers determine a unique answer modulo their product. It is a precise way to stitch local clues into a global solution.

Modern uses include fast arithmetic, cryptography, and coding theory. The old puzzle flavor hides a serious engineering idea: split a big computation into smaller independent tracks.

Why it matters: number theory keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
